units.note: Outside the error classes, for the record: (a) 'the guards are dismissed without accusation' - the subject of ἀπαλλάττονται is the patrolmen (οἱ ἔφοδοι), not the guards; (b) 'one in each of the two camps' - στρατόπεδον here means legion; (c) 'in daily rotation' slightly over-reads καθ᾽ ἡμέραν ('daily'). The chapter ends mid-sentence in the Greek (τοὔγκλημα opens ch. 37); the English seam is handled.

findings.quote: and most of them are killed on the spot inside the camp itself
findings.problem: τοὺς μὲν πλείστους ... καταβάλλουσι, τοῖς δ᾽ ἐκπεσεῖν δυναμένοις: the μέν/δέ pair contrasts the condemned men who are killed with those who escape. In the English, 'them' refers grammatically back to 'all the men in the camp', which makes the attackers the ones killed.
findings.proposed_fix: and most of those condemned are killed on the spot inside the camp itself

units.note: Not an error class: the English leaves out πολλαπλασίων αὐτοῖς ἐπιγινομένων ('when attacked by many times their number') and ἐν ταῖς ἐφεδρείαις in the sentence 'some men openly choose death at their post'.

ἐξ ἀρχῆς δὲ γαῖσον μόνον is disputed (it may mean the spear was the only original prize, or that the cavalryman originally got only a spear). The English 'In earlier times the spear alone was given' reads it the standard way and leaves it open enough.

Not an error class: 'the baggage of the second line behind the first' - the Greek τὰ τῶν δευτέρων [σημαιῶν] ἐπὶ ταῖς πρώταις σημαίαις means the baggage of the second maniples placed behind the first maniples. 'Line' could be confused with the three columns (hastati/principes/triarii). An editor may want 'maniples'.
